mapper.sql: SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT A.API_SPC_NO ,A.API_SPC_ID ,A.VER ,A.API_NM ,A.API_DESC ,A.AUT_ID ,A.SYS_ID ,COALESCE(A.VER_DESC,'') AS VER_DESC ,A.RFRN_WSDL_URL ,A.RFRN_TMPLT_NO ,A.RFRN_API_SPC_NO ,A.HOST ,A.BAS_PATH ,A.YAML_FILE_PATH ,A.YAML_FILE_NM ,A.REG_STTUS_CD ,A.TMPLT_YN ,COALESCE(A.REG_APVR,'') AS REG_APVR ,A.REG_DT ,COALESCE(A.REGR,'') AS REGR ,A.AMD_DT ,COALESCE(A.AMDR,'') AS AMDR ,A.DEL_YN ,COALESCE(A.DEL_DT,'') AS DEL_DT ,COALESCE(A.DELR,'') AS DELR ,A.YAML_SBST ,A.SHOW_YN ,COALESCE(A.API_CLASS,'') AS API_CLASS ,B.SORT_ODRG ,B.API_STATUS_CD ,COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS API_STATUS_CD_NM ,B.API_SUMRY ,B.USE_APPY_URL ,B.HTM_TAG_NM ,COALESCE(B.NEW_WIN_YN,'') AS NEW_WIN_YN ,C.TARGET_CD ,C.SAVE_FILE_NM ,C.ORIGIN_FILE_NM ,C.FILE_PATH ,C.FILE_TYPE_CD ,C.ON_SAVE_FILE_NM ,C.ON_ORIGIN_FILE_NM ,C.ON_FILE_TYPE_CD ,C.ON_FILE_PATH ,C.ON_FILE_SIZE ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.API_SPC_ID ORDER BY A.API_SPC_NO DESC ) RN FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A INNER JOIN V2OA_TB_SPC_INFO B ON (A.API_SPC_ID = B.API_SPC_ID) INNER JOIN V2OA_TB_API_ICON C ON (B.API_SPC_ID = C.API_SPC_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (B.API_STATUS_CD = D.COMN_CD) WHERE C.TARGET_CD = #{targetCd} AND COALESCE(A.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(A.SHOW_YN,'Y')= 'Y' AND NOT(A.TMPLT_YN != 'N' AND A.TMPLT_YN IS NOT NULL) AND A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030' ) A
mapper.select: SELECT /*com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiInfoDAO.selApiDefaultData*/ A.API_SPC_NO ,A.API_SPC_ID ,A.VER ,A.API_NM ,A.API_DESC ,A.AUT_ID ,A.SYS_ID ,COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS SYS_NM ,A.VER_DESC ,A.RFRN_WSDL_URL ,A.RFRN_TMPLT_NO ,A.RFRN_API_SPC_NO ,A.HOST ,A.BAS_PATH ,A.YAML_FILE_PATH ,A.YAML_FILE_NM ,A.REG_STTUS_CD ,A.TMPLT_YN ,A.REG_APVR ,A.REG_DT ,COALESCE(A.REGR, '') AS REGR ,A.AMD_DT ,COALESCE(A.AMDR, '') AS AMDR ,A.DEL_YN ,A.DEL_DT ,COALESCE(A.DELR, '') AS DELR ,A.YAML_SBST ,A.SHOW_YN ,A.API_CLASS ,B.API_NM AS TITLE_NM ,B.API_NO AS API_NO ,B.API_ID AS API_ID ,B.API_PATH AS API_PATH ,COALESCE(C.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD ,B.API_GUBUN ,COALESCE(C1.CD_NM,'') AS API_GUBUN_NM ,B.API_HANDLER_CD ,COALESCE(C2.CD_NM,'') AS API_HANDLER_CD_NM ,B.API_VER ,B.API_VER_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF B ON (A.API_SPC_NO = B.API_SPC_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C ON (B.METHOD_CD = C.COMN_CD AND C.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C1 ON (B.API_GUBUN = C1.COMN_CD AND C1.GROUP_CD = 'APIGUB1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C2 ON (B.API_HANDLER_CD = C2.COMN_CD AND C2.GROUP_CD = 'APIHDR1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C3 ON (B.ENDPNT_METHOD_CD = C3.COMN_CD AND C3.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.SYS_ID) WHERE (B.API_NO = #{apiNo}) AND (B.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo})

SELECT /*com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiInfoDAO.selApiMenuList*/
D.SYS_ID ,D.SYS_NM
D.API_NM ,D.API_SPC_NO ,D.VER
D.C_API_NM ,D.C_API_PATH ,D.API_NO
FROM ( SELECT A.SYS_ID ,A.SYS_NM ,B.API_NM ,B.BAS_PATH ,B.HOST ,B.AUT_ID ,B.API_SPC_NO ,C.API_NO ,C.API_NM AS C_API_NM ,C.API_PATH AS C_API_PATH ,C.API_ID ,C.SORT_ODRG ,COALESCE(C.API_CTGRY_NO,'') AS API_CTGRY_NO ,COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD ,B.VER FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC B ON A.SYS_ID = B.SYS_ID AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND ( B.TMPLT_YN != 'Y' OR B.TMPLT_YN IS NULL ) AND B.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030' AND B.SYS_ID NOT IN ('SHUB','AUTHENTI','INFRA','APPLICATI') INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF C ON B.API_SPC_NO = C.API_SPC_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (C.METHOD_CD = D.COMN_CD) ) AS D
WHERE D.SYS_ID = #{sysId}
WHERE D.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}
GROUP BY
D.SYS_ID, D.SYS_NM
D.API_SPC_NO, D.API_NM, D.VER
D.C_API_PATH, D.C_API_NM, D.API_NO
UNION ALL
SELECT
D.SYS_ID ,D.SYS_NM
D.API_NM ,D.API_SPC_NO ,D.VER
D.C_API_NM ,D.C_API_PATH ,D.API_NO
FROM ( SELECT A.SYS_ID ,A.SYS_NM ,B.API_NM ,B.BAS_PATH ,B.HOST ,B.AUT_ID ,B.API_SPC_NO ,C.API_NO ,C.API_NM AS C_API_NM ,C.API_PATH AS C_API_PATH ,C.API_ID ,C.SORT_ODRG ,C.API_CTGRY_NO ,COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY B.API_SPC_ID ORDER BY B.API_SPC_NO DESC ) RN ,B.VER FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC B ON A.SYS_ID = B.SYS_ID AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.SHOW_YN = 'Y' AND ( B.TMPLT_YN != 'Y' OR B.TMPLT_YN IS NULL ) AND B.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030' AND B.SYS_ID IN ('SHUB','AUTHENTI','INFRA','APPLICATI') LEFT OUTER JOIN V2OA_TB_API_ICON E ON B.API_SPC_ID = E.API_SPC_ID AND E.TARGET_CD = #{targetCd} LEFT OUTER JOIN V2OA_TB_SPC_INFO F ON E.API_SPC_ID = F.API_SPC_ID INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF C ON B.API_SPC_NO = C.API_SPC_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (C.METHOD_CD = D.COMN_CD) ) AS D WHERE 1=1
AND D.SYS_ID = #{sysId} AND D.RN = 1
AND D.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}
GROUP BY
D.SYS_ID, D.SYS_NM
D.API_SPC_NO, D.API_NM, D.VER
D.C_API_PATH, D.C_API_NM, D.API_NO
ORDER BY VER

SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiInfoDAO.select_API_TESTCASE */ TESTCASE_ID ,TESTCASE_NM ,PARAM_HEADER_JSON ,PARAM_BODY_JSON ,TO_CHAR(AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AMD_DT FROM KOA_TB_API_TESTCASE WHERE (API_NO = #{apiNo}) AND (INFOVIEW_YN = 'Y') AND (PARAM_GUB = 'json') ORDER BY AMD_DT DESC
